title: MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update (Mar 22) 🔥 Fokker F27 Friendship finally lands on PC!
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (March 22, 2026): The Fokker F27 Friendship is finally here! In this MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update, we explore the highly anticipated iniBuilds Fokker F27 Friendship for PC. If you are looking for the best MSFS aircraft 2026, this classic regional turboprop is a must-have for your hangar.

Stay up to date with the Microsoft Flight Simulator Weekly Update as we dive into the new MSFS aircraft and MSFS liveries hitting the store this week.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Microsoft/Inibuilds: Fokker F27 Friendship (Classic regional turboprop airliner)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 2Pilot: Enhanced cockpit red lights (Improved cockpit lighting visuals)
🎨 JED Studio: JEDS GotFriends DragoX liveries (Additional liveries for the DragoX)

If you enjoyed this quick Marketplace Update, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for weekly MSFS content, and drop a comment below letting us know which new release you’ll be flying first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
